verdict.rationale: Grafana's Observability as Code docs describe defining dashboards, data sources and other configuration in code for automated testing and CI/CD deployments. Its CLI is documented for authentication, multi-environment management and admin tasks from the terminal, and is explicitly called suitable for CI/CD pipelines. File-based provisioning, an official CLI page and an OpenAPI spec round out headless automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI/headless use.
